insight: A YC W24 startup; published a 2025 arXiv paper benchmarking its memory against prior agent-memory work.
name: Zep
tagline: Temporal knowledge-graph memory for AI agents.
description: Memory layer that gives agents long-term context by building a temporal knowledge graph from chat history and business data, tracking how facts evolve over time. It's powered by Graphiti, Zep's Apache-2.0 open-source temporal graph engine, with Zep Cloud offering a managed, credit-based service on top. Used to keep agent context relevant as conversations and data grow.

modelSupport.notes: Uses LLMs to extract entities/relations into a temporal graph.

edge: Stores a temporal knowledge graph (via OSS Graphiti) that versions how facts change over time, not flat snapshots.
